class.name: openral_hal_unitree/GuardedSafetyController
class.description: NVIDIA isaac_ros_deploy SafetyController with max_blend_ratio_speed capped at 1.0 /s and fixed at configure, blend_ratio reset to 0.0 on every activation, and a NaN position reference held at the pose captured at stale entry (v5.0 semantics).

class.name: openral_hal_unitree/GuardedInferenceController
class.description: NVIDIA isaac_ros_deploy InferenceController with v5.0's stale-input watchdog (topic_input_timeout_ms / topic_input_sources) on the v4.6 Jazzy release: a topic input older than the timeout invalidates the policy's commands.
